name: expert-builder
description: Creates and improves experts and skill packs with you in a short conversation: it asks a few questions, drafts the package where you can read it, lets you try it, and saves it to your Library when you say so.

quickPrompts.title: Create an expert
quickPrompts.prompt: Help me create a ___ expert that is good at ___. My background: [your field and experience]

quickPrompts.title: Create a skill pack
quickPrompts.prompt: Help me create a skill pack that teaches an agent to ___. It is used when ___. Example task: [an example]

welcome: I build experts and skill packs with you. Tell me what the expert should be good at, or what the skill should teach, and a little about your own background. I ask a few questions, draft it where you can read it, let you try it, and save it to your Library when you are happy. 我也可以用中文和你一起创建专家或技能包。
